L'application scanne le sous-réseau pour: The app scans the subnet to find the FluidNC board automatically.

La lecture de l'état machine et l'arrêt: Reading the machine state and the emergency stop are always allowed without confirmation, whatever these settings say.
La liaison va être coupée : l'app se déc: The link will drop: the app will disconnect for a few seconds while it reboots. Reconnection is automatic.
La machine démarre en alarme parce que l: The machine starts in alarm because the configuration requires homing. That is normal at power-up, not a fault.
La machine est verrouillée en alarme (fi: The machine is locked in alarm (limit switch OR emergency stop). Rearm it — soft reset then unlock — to allow a back-off move.
La machine est verrouillée.{} Lance la r: The machine is locked.{} Run the guided recovery to resume safely.
La machine va se déplacer au point calcu: The machine will move to the point computed by probing, then set the origin of coordinate system {} at that position (G10 L20). This changes the active work origin.
La position reste valide. Déverrouille,: The position is still valid. Unlock, then fix the work origin or the program — it is almost always a badly set work zero.
La sécurité de porte s'est déclenchée pe: The door safety tripped during homing.
Lancement de l'usinage avec notre algori: Machining starts with our character-counting algorithm for smooth, stutter-free streaming.
Lancement du cycle, mise en pause, arrêt: Cycle start, pause, emergency stop, or quick return to origin.
Langue de l'interface ET des réponses de: Language of the interface AND of the agent's replies, dictation and speech included. On automatic, the interface follows the system and the agent replies in the language of the message it receives. G-code, axis names and alarm codes are never translated.
Langue peu dotée : contrôle la qualité d: Low-resource language: check the quality of the replies before relying on them in the workshop, and prefer Gemini Flash over Flash Lite. Dictation and speech may be missing from the device — written chat always works.
Le G-code demandait un déplacement au-de: The G-code asked for a move beyond the machine's declared travel. The move was refused before it ran.
Le bouton magique ! Activez-le pour pass: The magic button! Turn it on for the simplified “High Visibility” interface.
Le bouton rouge central est accessible p: The central red button is reachable everywhere. One press freezes the machine at once.
Le cockpit central de votre machine. Tou: Your machine's central cockpit. Everything is built for shop-floor efficiency.
Le contrôleur n'a pas pu confirmer l'éta: The controller could not confirm the requested spindle state.
Le homing amène la machine sur ses fins: Homing drives the machine onto its limit switches to establish the absolute reference (machine zero). Do it at startup, before setting a work origin.
Le mouvement a été interrompu net, sans: The move was cut short, with no deceleration.
Le palpeur n'a rien touché sur toute la: The probe touched nothing over the whole programmed distance.
Le palpeur était déjà en contact avant l: The probe was already in contact before the cycle began.
Le programme demande S{}. Cette valeur n: The program asks for S{}. That value only applies if the spindle is speed-controlled; on an on/off spindle it is ignored.
Le programme ne décrit pas cet outil : i: The program does not describe this tool: it only gives its number. Nothing is shown rather than inventing values.
The program does not describe this tool.
Le redémarrage va couper la liaison : l': Restarting drops the link: the app will be disconnected for a few seconds while the ESP32 reboots. Reconnection is automatic.
Le tour d'horizon est terminé. Vous avez: The tour is over. You now have everything you need to drive your CNC with Forgeron.
Lecture des paramètres depuis la carte…: Reading the settings from the board…
Les 5 axes vont relâcher leur couple et: All 5 axes will release their torque and turn freely. WARNING: the Z axis is no longer held and can FALL. Make sure Z is down or secured. The motors re-enable on the next move.
Les outils sont lus dans le G-code. Char: Tools are read from the G-code. Load a program from the workspace to see the ones it uses.
Tools are read from the G-code. Load a program from the PROGRAM tab to see the ones it uses.
Les valeurs de cinématique actuelles ser: The current kinematics values will be written to config.yaml (permanent), then FluidNC will restart to apply them.

Passe au modèle suivant quand le quota d: Moves to the next model when the daily quota is hit (429) — adds the quotas up.
Plusieurs axes partagent un capteur et l: Several axes share one switch and the controller cannot tell which one is involved.
Pose une question ou demande une action: Ask a question or request an action on your 5-axis CNC.
Position du zéro pièce, exprimée en coor: Position of the work zero, in MACHINE coordinates. On a machine whose zero is at the switches, these values are normally negative.
Presse manuellement chaque fin de course: Press each limit switch by hand. The matching axis must turn ACTIVE. Check it is the right axis and the right direction.
Procédure guidée de mesure de longueur d: Guided procedure to measure tool length with an automated probe.
Rapproche le palpeur de la pièce ou augm: Move the probe closer to the part or increase the search distance.
Reconnaissance vocale indisponible sur c: Speech recognition is unavailable on this device.
Refais une prise d'origine : la position: Home again: the real position no longer matches the one the controller thinks it has.
Referme la porte et relance la prise d'o: Close the door and start homing again.
Rejoins le point d'accès de l'ESP32 dire: Join the ESP32 access point straight from the app. Android will ask for approval the first time; after that reconnection is automatic (even after a reboot).
Reprise automatique dès le retour du rés: Automatic resume as soon as the network is back…
Rien à configurer : connectez-vous au Wi: Nothing to configure: connect to the machine's WiFi and the camera is found on its own. It shares that network with the controller, so the frame rate drops during machining to let the G-code through.
Routines automatiques de palpage surface: Automatic surface and centring probing routines with the [PRB:] result returned.
Simulateur 3D non supporté sur cette pla: 3D simulator not supported on this platform
Surveillance de la latence, du débit, et: Watch latency, throughput and the state of the GRBL buffer.
Surveillez en un coup d'œil l'état de co: See the connection state and the live status of your FluidNC machine at a glance.
Sélectionne un outil dans la liste: Pick a tool from the list

Sélectionnez un système de coordonnées p: Pick a work coordinate system; clicking sends G54/G55/G56 to the machine.
Séquence recommandée : Z → X → Y → A → C: Recommended order: Z → X → Y → A → C

Un capteur (fin de course, porte, arrêt): A switch (limit, door, stop) was already active at power-up.
Un capteur de fin de course a été touché: A limit switch was hit during a probing cycle.
A limit switch was hit during a move. The machine stopped dead.
Un circuit d'extension d'entrées/sorties: An I/O expander chip restarted: the state of its pins is no longer reliable.
Un mouvement exigeant une position machi: A move requiring a known machine position was requested before any homing.
Un reset est survenu alors que la machin: A reset happened while the machine was moving. It was stopped with no deceleration.
Un reset est survenu pendant le cycle de: A reset happened during the homing cycle.
Une erreur dans le programme a mis la ma: An error in the program put the machine into alarm.
Une fois l'axe dégagé et toutes les buté: Once the axis is clear and every switch released, run homing again to restore machine zero.
Utilise G10 L20 pour définir l'origine p: Uses G10 L20 to set the work origin at the current position in one click.
Visualisation ultra-claire des positions: Crystal-clear view of the machine positions. Switch between Machine (MPos) and Work (WPos) coordinates in one click.
Visualisez les mouvements de la cinémati: Watch the trunnion kinematics move in real time.

Vérifie l'alimentation et le câblage de: Check the spindle's power supply and wiring. On a relay-driven spindle, check the module really switches — an underpowered supply causes this fault.
Vérifie le câblage du palpeur et qu'il e: Check the probe wiring and that it is clear, then run the cycle again.
Vérifie le câblage et le sens de déplace: Check the wiring and the axis travel direction, or increase the search distance. An axis moving the wrong way gives exactly this fault.
Vérifiez que l'ESP32 est allumé et sur l: Check that the ESP32 is powered and on the same WiFi.
Zéro machine établi, cinématique vérifié: Machine zero established, kinematics checked and work origin set. You can load a program and start the cycle.

Writes the current values to config.yaml (permanent) then restarts FluidNC to apply them.

Éloigne l'axe touché de la butée par PET: Move the tripped axis away from the switch in SMALL steps (pick ×1), in the OPPOSITE direction to the limit switch. Jogging is allowed even with the switch active so you can back off.
